buyListNote: Sealed product (2026-09-17): the 30th Celebration line, now launched, technically clears the 15-20% EV-over-price rule on paper, but ~81% of per-pack EV rides on the <6% combined odds of a Special Illustration Rare or Futuristic Rare pull, priced off thin day-1/day-2 sales — treating this as launch hype, not an actionable edge, and holding off on a sealed pick until prices settle (revisit in 2-3 weeks). Mega Evolution: Pitch Black still rejected (EV ~35% below its $197.78 street price). Espeon ex/Umbreon ex Battle Decks (Oct 30) still lack real secondary pricing.
